verdict.rationale: TruffleHog offers filtering via --include-detectors/--verify-detectors flags and --since-commit to scope scans, which can reduce noise, but there is no evidence of a baseline/ignore-list mechanism, findings suppression database, or persistent 'mark as false positive' workflow to prevent re-alerting on already-triaged findings. missing for 10: baseline snapshot feature, allowlist/ignore-list of specific findings, false-positive marking/suppression persisted across scans, evidence of noise-reduction workflow beyond detector-level filtering.
